drivingQuestion: What additional case does the mishna's 'everyone is qualified to sprinkle' come to include?
outcomeNote: The clause is given its inclusion and grounded in Rabbi Elazar's ruling; nothing is raised against it.

segments.he: ״הַכֹּל כְּשֵׁירִין לְהַזּוֹת״ — לְאֵתוֹיֵי מַאי? לְאֵתוֹיֵי עָרֵל, וְכִדְרַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר, דְּאָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר: עָרֵל שֶׁהִזָּה — הַזָּאָתוֹ כְּשֵׁרָה.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «What is added» by the statement of the mishna (Para 12:10): «Everyone is qualified to sprinkle» the purification waters on one who is ritually impure with impurity imparted by a corpse? The Gemara answers that this serves «to add one who is uncircumcised. And» this is «in accordance with» the opinion «of Rabbi Elazar, as Rabbi Elazar says:» If «one who is uncircumcised sprinkled» the purification water, «his sprinkling is valid.»
